title: Mission na Ville ya Kala
intro: Engumba ya kala oyo etondi na mputulu, bato na yango bakangamaki na bowangani, mpe likebisi ya nsuka oyo bato batyaki likebi te. Lelo oyo, bo kota na rôle ya ba oyo Allah atindaki pona ko livrer message na peuple ya motó makasi. Lisolo ya koboya, mongongo ya bondimi ya bobele moko, mpe nsuka ekangamaki na mobeko moko ya kobebisa. Nani alobaka na nzela ya bilembo yango?
clues: Totindamaki na Allah na engumba oyo bato na yango batikaki bosolo
Mibale kati na biso toyaki liboso, nsima moto ya misato asanganaki mpo na kolendisa misio na biso
Bato ya mboka baboyaki biso, balobaki ete tozali eloko mosusu te kaka bato lokola bango
Molimo moko oyo eutaki na nsuka ya mosika mpenza ya engumba ekendeki mbangu mpo na koyebisa bato bálanda biso
Tobondelaki bango, kasi bakómisaki mitema na bango makasi mpe babalukaki kotɛmɛla biso
Na kolela moko ya kobebisa oyo euti na likoló, engumba na biso mobimba ekangamaki monɔkɔ

identity.label: Nazali Nani?
options: Bamemi-nsango ya Mboka na Surah Ya-Sin
Ba Hawwariyyun (Bayekoli ya Isa) .
Bandoki ya Ndako ya Farao
Baninga ya Sabata
Bato ya Nkoi
identity.answer: Bamemi-nsango ya Mboka na Surah Ya-Sin

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Bato ya engumba baboyaki mpe babengaki bango bato ya lokuta
Azikisamaki na bomoi na mɔ́tɔ monene oyo ezalaki kopela mɔ́tɔ
Emelamaki na mbisi monene na kati ya mbu mozindo
Batindi bango na makasi mpo na kotonga likonzí moko molai
Banyokolamaki na kati ya libulu ya mɔ́tɔ oyo ezalaki makasi
trial.answer: Bato ya engumba baboyaki mpe babengaki bango bato ya lokuta

location.label: Elemento ya ntina
options: Engumba ya kala (al-Qaryah) .
Litumbu monene oyo ezali kopela mɔtɔ
Libumu ya mbisi monene
Likonzí oyo etombwami oyo esimbaka likoló
Ndako ya bule (Kaaba) .

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Engumba yango ebebisamaki na kolela moko ya kobebisa (Sayha) .
Mokonzi ya bokonzi mpe basoda na ye bazindaki na mbu oyo ekabwanaki
Bato yango babongwanaki na banyoka mpe banyoka
Mbula ya mabanga oyo eutaki na likoló ebebisaki engumba yango
Mpela moko ya mobulu elongolaki bato nyonso ya mboka
outcome.answer: Engumba yango ebebisamaki na kolela moko ya kobebisa (Sayha) .

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
